# Support

Codex Partner is a community-maintained open-source project. The fastest route
depends on what you are trying to solve.

## Something is broken

Use the [bug report template](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml). Search existing
open and closed issues first, then include the edition, exact version, Windows
version, installation type, affected provider, and the smallest reproducible
steps.

The Native C++ edition can prepare a bounded report from **About → Report a
problem**. Review the copied text before pasting it. Never include API keys,
cookies, OAuth tokens, credential files, private provider responses, or account
identifiers.

## You have an idea

Use the [feature request template](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.yml). Explain
the user problem and frequency before proposing UI or architecture; this makes
small, high-value solutions easier to recognize.

## Setup and usage

- Start with the root [README](../README.md).
- Build and test instructions: [`docs/BUILDING.md`](../docs/BUILDING.md).
- Provider configuration: [`docs/PROVIDERS.md`](../docs/PROVIDERS.md).
- Browser-cookie behavior: [`docs/COOKIES.md`](../docs/COOKIES.md).
- Data handling: [`docs/PRIVACY.md`](../docs/PRIVACY.md).

Provider billing disputes, subscription changes, account recovery, and service
outages must be handled by that provider. Codex Partner displays local/provider
usage evidence but cannot change a provider account.

## Security-sensitive reports

Do not file them as ordinary bugs. Follow the private process in
[`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md).

Participation in project spaces is governed by the
[`CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
